entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jean Paul Timoléon de Cossé, 7th Duke of Brissac, was a French general during the reign of King Louis XV. He is most notable for leading the French vanguard at the Battle of Minden, and he became a Marshal of France. He held the French noble title of Duke of Brissac and was also a Grand Panetier of France.
